knownLimits: Full multimodal quality and endurance remain unverified. Current v1.2.2 m04 template/native-parser, SDK/direct phone probes and actual full DSH tasks have separate version-specific evidence; historical failures and older m15/UI evidence retain their original identity. Guided tool acceptance does not establish arbitrary agent reliability.
m03/m09/m16 projector provenance remains unresolved; no fabricated compatible preset.
Public OpenAI chat accepts text only; App visual bridge is a separate path.
Native audio/3D understanding and arbitrary HF execution are not inferred from catalogue tags.
Historical 3D empty_structure and weak video quality remain recorded.
